identity: Glassroot Wilds is the last elven forest before the front: the gate wardens tend the old roots while wolves run the fringe, apes and panthers hold the tangle, and the canopy has a king who answers to nobody.

quests.title: [PH] Something Fresh for the Carriers
quests.text: [PH] Faeris Rootbinder wants the carriers on the grown paths to have something fresh: bring 5 Melons. Real text to follow.

variants.text: [PH] Faeris Rootbinder wants the carriers on the grown paths to have something fresh: bring 5 Melons. Real text to follow.
[PH] Rumela Stormstep's carriers come back soaked and hungry: bring 5 Melons. Real text to follow.

quests.lesson: A shared errand, the zone's first; the first armor choice (one enchant, a prefix).
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. Draft §3 'Something Fresh for the Carriers': Melons for the carriers (Faeris, Rumela).

quests.title: [PH] Keep the Stores Dry
quests.text: [PH] Faeris needs Chests so stores and spare material stay usable between runs: bring 3 Chests. Real text to follow.

variants.text: [PH] Faeris needs Chests so stores and spare material stay usable between runs: bring 3 Chests. Real text to follow.
[PH] Orrel Hollowstep keeps recovered belongings dry until they go home: bring 3 Chests. Real text to follow.
[PH] Rumela keeps message gear and stores dry between the rains: bring 3 Chests. Real text to follow.

quests.lesson: A shared errand, a level only; the zone's early potion choice.
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. Draft §3 'Keep the Stores Dry': dry keeping for stores, personal effects and message gear (Faeris, Orrel, Rumela).

quests.title: [PH] Supplies Through Cinderline
quests.text: [PH] Faeris sends the player to Toren Waterbarrel at Cinderline Watch, where the same supply problems run; no earlier deed is claimed. Real text to follow.
quests.lesson: A travel quest, free (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. The id stays (its objectives are unchanged); free, it requires nothing.

quests.title: [PH] A Path for Those Coming Back
quests.text: [PH] Faeris wants a prepared snare on the carriers' path loosened at the {name:carrier_path} in the {name:canopy}, so her wardens can watch that stretch again. Real text to follow.
quests.completion: [PH] The stretch of path is usable again; a concrete relief, nothing more. Real text to follow.
quests.lesson: The zone's solo quest; the weapon choice (prefix and suffix).
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. K7 A: the zone's solo quest with its weapon, at a new recipe place in the Canopy, 64 nodes from Canopy-Knuckle (the place rule).

quests.title: [PH] Party: The Canopy's Own King
quests.text: [PH] Faeris asks for a party against {name:canopy_knuckle} in the {name:canopy}, who has hurt her wardens and broken their bows; optional, nothing needs it. Real text to follow.
quests.lesson: The optional group quest: free, standalone, a trinket choice as its extra.
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. The optional group quest (round61-plan.md §2 point 8): free, standalone, a trinket choice as its extra.

quests.title: [PH] Where the Front Begins
quests.text: [PH] Faeris sends the player to Nella Hedgeward at Last Hedge Redoubt; Canopy-Knuckle's fall is not assumed. Real text to follow.
quests.lesson: A travel quest, free (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. The departure at 40 (round61-plan.md §2 point 7); free, it requires nothing.
